params.name: LScan
params.desc: if true a scan will be performed.

params.name: LExtend
params.desc: if true an already existing scan output file will be extended rather than overwritten.

params.name: Scan_para
params.desc: parameter to be scanned. Valid are all parameters that are written in italic letters in the namelist tables of chapter 6.

params.name: S_min
params.desc: minimal set point of the scanning parameter.

params.name: S_max
params.desc: maximal set point of the scanning parameter.

params.name: O_min
params.desc: if true the minimum of the parameter FOM(1) is searched with decreasing interval size around the minimum.

params.name: O_max
params.desc: if true the maximum of the parameter FOM(1) is searched with decreasing interval size around the maximum.

params.name: O_match
params.desc: if true the match of the parameter FOM(1) to the match_value is searched with decreasing interval size around the optimum.

params.name: match_value
params.desc: value to which FOM(1) has to be matched if O_match = true.

params.name: O_depth
params.desc: optimization depth if one of O_min, O_max or O_match is true. The total number of runs is about S_numb · O_depth.

params.name: S_zmin
params.desc: minimum position for the search of an optimum of FOM(1)

params.name: S_zmax
params.desc: maximum position for the search of an optimum of FOM(1)

params.name: S_dz
params.desc: the interval S_zmin to S_zmax is divided into S_dz equal intervals. At the end of each interval emittances etc. are calculated.
